title: The Agricultural Revolution in Britain 1700-1800: Transforming Farming and Society The Industrial Revolution Begins i...
reason: Transcript describes the agricultural revolution and technological improvements in farming during the Industrial Revolution.

tasks.task: Describe the historical context of the agricultural revolution in Britain.

subtasks.text: Mention the period of great social, political and economic upheaval across the globe from 1900 to 1914.
Observe that the Industrial Revolution began in Britain during the early part of the 18th century.
Note that prior to the Industrial Revolution, life in Britain had remained largely unchanged for generations.

tasks.task: Explain the pre-Industrial Revolution system of farming in Britain.

subtasks.text: Describe how peasants relied on subsistence farming that produced just enough food for themselves.
Highlight the three-field system used for crop rotation, with two productive and one fallow field.
Mention that livestock would graze in the fallow field to help fertilize the soil.

tasks.task: Describe the changes brought about by land enclosure and peasant unemployment.

subtasks.text: Observe that 16th century landowners started turning open fields into enclosed paddocks.
Note that peasants lost the ability to strip farm and sometimes could not access water.
Mention the two options available to unemployed peasants: working as hired labourers or seeking employment in town.

tasks.task: Describe the technological improvements in farming.

subtasks.text: Highlight Jethro Tull's invention of the horse-drawn seed drill in 1700.
Observe that prior to Jethro Tull's invention, seeds were thrown by hand into plowed furrows.
Note the dramatic improvement in crop yields by Jethro Tull's seed drill.
Highlight Joseph Follyamby’s invention of the Rotherham Triangular Plow in 1730.
Mention how the Rotherham Plow made farming lighter, easier, and more time-efficient.

tasks.task: Describe the impact of Lord Charles Townsend's introduction of the four-crop rotation system.

subtasks.text: Highlight the four-crop rotation system introduced by Lord Turnip Townsend in the 1730s.
Observe that the system rotated wheat, turnips, and barley through four fields.
Note that turnips helped nourish the soil with nutrients and improved future crop yields.
Mention that turnips were fed to livestock during winter months.

tasks.task: Describe the social and economic impact of these agricultural advancements.

subtasks.text: Observe that improvements in farming reduced the need for as many people to produce more food.
Note the transformation of farming from primarily satisfying basic needs into a commercial opportunity.
